scripts.build:apps: npm run build:client && npm run build:staff
scripts.cap:sync: npm run build && npx cap sync
scripts.cap:android: npm run build && npx cap sync android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios: npm run build && npx cap sync ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:sync-client: npm run build:client && npx cap sync -c capacitor.config.client.ts android && npx cap sync -c capacitor.config.client.ts ios
scripts.cap:sync-staff: npm run build:staff && npx cap sync -c capacitor.config.staff.ts android && npx cap sync -c capacitor.config.staff.ts ios
scripts.cap:android-client: npm run build:client && npx cap sync -c capacitor.config.client.ts android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:android-staff: npm run build:staff && npx cap sync -c capacitor.config.staff.ts android && npx cap open android
scripts.cap:ios-client: npm run build:client && npx cap sync -c capacitor.config.client.ts ios && npx cap open ios
scripts.cap:ios-staff: npm run build:staff && npx cap sync -c capacitor.config.staff.ts ios && npx cap open ios
